placeholder.name: The name shown, or an i18n key (e.g. menu.iam.user)
placeholder.component: A path under src/views, e.g. platform/iam/user/index
placeholder.componentName: The component name pages are cached by, e.g. IamUser
placeholder.routeName: A unique route name, e.g. iam-user
placeholder.groupRouteName: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. erp-sale (from the route path)

menu.routeNameFixed: A group's route name is fixed once saved: seeds and generated pages find the group by it
